To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the public opinion is negative towards migration in the European countries and the factors causing negative attitudes are the unemployment, crime rate, and the number of immigrants.

(1) We present a Knowledge Base of Public Opinion towards Migration and its Driving Factors, MigrationsKB, (2) We analyze the public opinion on migration using advanced NLP techniques, (3) We identify the factors that influence the public attitudes towards migration using external data, (4) We integrate the findings in a KB, (5) We make MigrationsKB publicly available using FAIR principles.
1) the public attitudes towards migration in Europe are mostly negative and 2) economic factors play an important role in the formation of these attitudes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following contributions: (1) We have collected a large-scale dataset of 1.2M tweets from 10 countries.
the analysis of social data and integration of the outcomes into a KB.
the identification of factors driving negative attitudes of the public towards migration and their integration into a KB.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MigrationsKB is a novel knowledge base that integrates the public attitudes towards migration and the economic indicators to understand the public opinion on migration in Europe.
the proposed MigrationsKB is a comprehensive and unique resource which can help in better understanding of the public opinions towards migration and the factors driving these opinions.
the proposed KB can be used as a benchmark to analyze the social attitudes towards migration and the driving factors in the European countries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have built a knowledge base of public attitudes towards migration in European countries.
we have developed a novel knowledge base for public opinion towards migrations and its driving factors.
we have developed a KB that captures the public opinion towards migrations in Europe, which is the first of its kind.
The main takeaway from our work is that
public attitudes towards migrants are influenced by various economic factors such as unemployment, GDP, and population growth.
public attitudes are significantly influenced by social and economic factors and that these attitudes are not static but change over time.
the public attitude towards migration is a combination of the economic factors and social media discourses.
